Package gui

Class ReservationManagementController

java.lang.Object
gui.ReservationManagementController
All Implemented Interfaces:
IReservationDeleter, IReservationViewer, Initializable
public class ReservationManagementController extends Object implements Initializable, IReservationViewer, IReservationDeleter
Controller for the Reservation Management screen. This class handles viewing, searching, and cancelling restaurant reservations. It allows restaurant staff to search for reservations by different modes: - Show All: Retrieves all reservations. - By Attribute: Search by specific attributes (status, table ID, guests, code). - By Date Range: Search for reservations within a specific time period. Implements IReservationViewer to receive reservation lists from the server and IReservationDeleter to handle cancellation responses.
